targets.old_statement: Passing on the right is allowed only when it is safe and the other driver is turning left, and you must never pass on the left of a driver who has signaled a left turn.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Passing on the right is allowed only when it is safe and the other driver is turning left, and you must never pass on the left of a driver who has signaled a left turn.
targets.statement: Passing on the right is permitted only when safe and either the driver ahead is turning left, you are on an open highway clearly marked for two or more lanes in your direction, or you are in a business or residential district marked for two or more lanes in your direction; never leave the paved or main roadway to pass on the right, and never pass to the left of a driver signaling a left turn.
